description: Find a product the user has already chosen, by exact name, model number or barcode (UPC/EAN), and get its id for compare_prices. Use this when the user is ready to buy: they ask where to buy it, for the best price now, whether a price is a good deal, or for a link. For a parts or shopping list, search each item. A brand or category search works too ('eufy security cameras'): one call returns up to 10 different models, so use it to list what a brand sells with prices. Not for opinions on what is best (e.g. 'best headphones under $200'): decide that yourself, then search for the chosen model. Do not use for recall or safety questions (use check_recalls).

brand.description: Only this brand, e.g. 'Dyson', when the user names one

condition.description: new unless the user asks for used, open-box or refurbished; 'used' covers all of those

in_stock_only.description: Only products with at least one in-stock offer

max_price.description: Highest price in USD, e.g. 100 for 'under $100'

min_price.description: Lowest price in USD, when the user gives a budget floor

query.description: A product name, model number or UPC/EAN, e.g. 'Sony WH-1000XM6' or '045496884963', or a brand plus category, e.g. 'eufy security cameras'

name: search_products
title: Shopper: search products
